rite.prompt: Which short book does Hall name as the root grammar of the Qabbalistic system in this chapter?

signal:
QABBALAH.NFO                                       HALL 1.3
================================================================
The Qabbalah, the Secret Doctrine of Israel
Manly P. Hall · 1928 · folio p.346 · ECHO QBL.TREE

THESIS
  Beside the written Torah sits an unwritten one: a doctrine
  in which letters, numbers, and names are the same object.

POINTS
  * Pike: a theology you can count on your fingers
  * Simeon ben Jochai and the Zohar as later flowering
  * Sepher Yetzirah: 32 paths (10 sephiroth + 22 letters)
  * Gematria, notarikon, temurah — three keys to a text
  * Not a museum of folklore; a diagram of emanation

SEE ALSO  sephiroth  tarot  keys-to-man  pythagorean-math
DEGREE    NEOPHYTE may read this screen
================================================================
translation:
Hall borrows Albert Pike’s awe and then tries to make it operational. Qabbalah, here, is not “Jewish mysticism” as a mood. It is a claim that the Hebrew alphabet is a periodic table: twenty-two letters, ten numbers, one Name, and a way the Infinite becomes a world without breaking.

He distinguishes the written law from the unwritten. The public text is the husk; the Qabbalah is the method for reading the husk as a diagram. The Sepher Yetzirah is the short, hard book — God engraves the universe with thirty-two paths of wisdom. The Zohar is the long, late, literary one. Gematria (letter-as-number), notarikon (acronyms), and temurah (permutation) are the three picks you use on a locked verse.

Hall is a synthesist, not a rabbi. He will immediately hook this to Pythagoras (number as being), to tarot (22 trumps as 22 letters), to the Tree in the next file. That is the correspondence engine this BBS is built to walk.

Codex, on the lot, already calculates Hebrew values. This board uses the same idea on Hall’s own English: type a word, find every other word in the folio that sums the same. That is Hall’s “numerical cipher” chapter applied to Hall.
